notes.title: Upcoming major update: The First Expansion
notes.notes:
Hi, Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD has sold 10K+ units on Steam. Yay!!!!

Thank you so much for the support! 

Now it's time for celebration, and the only right way to do it is by adding more content to the game 🤘

So, I officially announce The First Expansion DLC (a.k.a update v1.2) is coming, it is free, of course. It will bring new game modes and accompanying contents, as well as many improvements to the game. Expect it will be BIG!

The DLC will be released on 19 Feb 2025 (PST) You can wishlist it now to get notified:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334720/Towerful_Defense_A_Rogue_TD__The_First_Expansion/

Meanwhile, if you have any suggestions for the update, I'd be very glad to hear it in the comment section.

Talking about defending the Earth...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215685/d7785a85e776111db580b54838d7a646b83ea099.png
I'm a solo dev and I was completely working from while working on this game. The development of the game emitted approximately 323.44 kg of CO2, and that scored an A rating on the sustainability scale of a sale event the game is participating. The sale is happening on Steam soon with many other games revealing their CO2 emission and rating, watch out for it!

Look further into the future...
I'm experimenting around with a new game whose premise goes like this: Shoot your way out of a relentless pursuit in the middle of a desert in your armed truck to deliver a stolen Time Relic. Harness the relic's power to aid your escape, but brace yourself for the unimaginable consequences.

Wishlist it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293650/Relic_Delivery/

Now back to the present, I still need your help...

If you like the game, please leave Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD a review. 
Your support makes the updates and expansions possible.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215685/1ce1463aec192d7ec75ff69c339125af7237a24d.png

Thank you and see you next time!

notes.title: v1.1.17 update notes
notes.notes:
Hello, towerful defenders!

Thank you for your support, I’m still working hard to improve the game according to your feedback and add new content, features that I think you’ll love.

There’s more coming, and here are update notes for the latest version, v1.1.17.

- NEW: when your skills cost the tower's HP, the skills' cards now display exactly how much HP they cost
- NEW: tower Invt, it has a twist on tower bullet damage
- NEW: artifact ELYM
- NEW: Auto skill interval is now more precise with 0.2 second step
- NEW: custom Endless mode, now you can choose which cursed items you'll get in the Endless mode, you can choose to get none of them.
- REBALANCED: Mother Ship spawns less meteors in first Hostilities
- REBALANCED: limit effective % Money at 500%
- REBALANCED: limit effective Luck at 100
- REBALANCED: HISF now also -1 Max HP
- REBALANCED: NDLS now also -1 Armor
- REBALANCED: remove Blind Bless, BEEM, MASS (in that order) after wave 39, 49, 59
- REBALANCED: add Endless Curse I after wave 69
- REBALANCED: max chance a Glitchy appears is now 35%
- REBALANCED: skill enhancements will appear less after wave 19
- REBALANCED: enemies' HPs will grow significantly faster after wave 35
- IMPROVED: Dormant Power's English description (thanks, Hank Hill on Discord)

If you love the game, please leave me a review on Steam, it is huge motivation that helps me to continue working on the game and deliver more content.

- Improved: the story scene before starting a new run.
- Fixed: starting a new run by using the Next hostility button didn't reduce the first skill's cooldown time.
- Fixed: the item that doubles a random main stat sometimes didn't double any stat.

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is in June, and Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD is going to be proudly part of the event.

To celebrate, It's time for the demo's big update, a whole new system: Talent Points. You earn Talent Points by beating certain waves and you get to keep the points permanently. You can use the points to straight buy main stats or to use with new cards that leverage the points.

Try it yourself now, and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist as the launch day is coming closer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2453610/Towerful_Defense_A_Rogue_TD/

notes.title: We've got covered by Wanderbots! Next big update to demo?
notes.notes:
It's needless to say, but I'm going to say it anyway, as a solo indie dev, I'm so happy that my hard work gets to be known by many more people, it made my day and days after that. Wanderbots is very close to the indie community and helps bring the games to their deserved audience. I'm very thankful for his help.  Check the video below of him playing Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD, and make sure to check other cool games he played as well!

I'm working toward the next big update for the game and the demo as well. Expect significant improvement in graphics, balancing, new content,...I aim to release the new demo by the end of March 2024. Meanwhile, let's wishlist and follow so you won't miss anything.
